answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a stake-gated identity registry with correlated slashing. Each agent locks a bond for one voting identity; the system groups identities sharing funding or lockstep behavior, and one proven fake forfeits the whole cluster's bonds. N fake votes therefore require N separate bonds, all at risk, while honest rewards stay capped per identity. In a market for onyx, shale and cedar, the bond capital needed to pose as onyx, shale and cedar traders exceeds any reward, so cloned keys never pay.
